knowledge:
- key_parameters: patterns=A character vector of unique, non-nested variable tags used by cols() to identify and index biological replicate columns ;; alpha_bounds=A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the lower and upper bounds for the initial decay rate (alpha), typically calculated using a_low() and a_high() ;; beta_bounds=A numeric vector of length 2 specifying the lower and upper bounds for the decay of decay rate (beta), typically calculated using b_low() and a user-defined upper limit ;; what=A character vector in decay_plot() specifying which elements to plot, such as "meanSE", "reps", "models", "Desc", or "alphas&betas" ;; hl_dist_treatment=The treatment name in hl_plot() used to define the baseline half-life distribution background
- alternatives: The documentation mentions that the workflow can be adapted to analyze individual gene data from quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR) measures, though normalization is best performed using a number of stable reference genes.
- when_to_use: Use this package when analyzing transcriptomic time-course data (up to 4 treatments/genotypes) following transcriptional inhibition (e.g., using ActinomycinD or cordycepin) to model and compare RNA decay rates and dynamics.
- pitfalls: Column name tags must be unique and non-nested (e.g., use '00' instead of '0', and avoid overlapping names like 'vcs' and 'vcs sov' by using 'vs' instead) to prevent grep pattern matching errors in cols() ;; The input data frame decay_data must be sorted in a specific order (by t.decay, then rep, then treatment, then geneID) before running model optimization ;; Modeling all genes across all models is highly computationally intensive (e.g., ~10 hours for 118 genes on a single core); parallel processing using parallel::mclapply is highly recommended for genome-wide datasets ;; The modeling framework is strictly limited to a maximum of 4 experimental treatments.

workflows.name: rna_decay_analysis
workflows.intent: Normalize raw RPM RNA-seq decay data, correct for total RNA pool depletion, fit constant and decaying decay models, and visualize decay curves and half-lives.
input: RPMs (A data frame of RPM values with column names consisting of unique, non-nested variable tags separated by underscores, and rownames as unique gene identifiers)
stablegenes (A character vector of abundant and stable reference gene IDs)
descriptions (An optional named character vector of gene descriptions)
workflows.stages: 1. Index replicate columns using cols() and calculate mean and standard error of RPMs ;; 2. Perform T0 normalization by dividing all time points by the mean T0 value ;; 3. Calculate decay factors from stable reference genes and apply decay factor correction ;; 4. Reshape the corrected data into a long-format data frame ;; 5. Sort the data frame (required step) and define equivalence constraint groups using groupings() ;; 6. Determine alpha and beta parameter bounds using a_low(), a_high(), and b_low() ;; 7. Perform maximum likelihood parameter optimization using mod_optimization() ;; 8. Select the best model per gene using the AICc statistic ;; 9. Plot decay curves using decay_plot() and half-life distributions using hl_plot()
workflows.code:
library(RNAdecay)
RPMs <- RNAdecay::RPMs

# T0 Normalization
mean_RPM <- data.frame("geneID" = rownames(RPMs))
SE_RPM <- data.frame("geneID" = rownames(RPMs))
for(g in treatment){
  for(t in tdecay){
    mean_RPM <- cbind(mean_RPM, rowMeans(RPMs[, cols(df=RPMs, patterns = c(g, t))]))
    names(mean_RPM)[length(mean_RPM)] <- paste0(g, "_", t)
    SE_RPM <- cbind(SE_RPM, apply(X = RPMs[, cols(df=RPMs, patterns = c(g, t))], MARGIN = 1, FUN = stats::sd)/sqrt(length(reps)))
    names(SE_RPM)[length(SE_RPM)] <- paste0(g, "_", t)
  }}

mT0norm <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(RPMs)[filt1])
for(g in treatment){
  mean_T0reps <- rowMeans(RPMs[filt1, cols(df=RPMs, patterns=c(g, "00"))])
  for(r in reps){
    df <- RPMs[filt1, colnames(RPMs)[cols(df=RPMs, patterns=c(g, r))]]
    df <- df[, 1:length(tdecay)]/mean_T0reps
    mT0norm <- cbind(mT0norm, df)
  }}

# Decay Factor Correction
stablegenes <- c( "ATCG00490", "ATCG00680", "ATMG00280", "ATCG00580", "ATCG00140", "AT4G38970", "AT2G07671", "ATCG00570", "ATMG00730", "AT2G07727", "AT2G07687", "ATMG00160" ,"AT3G11630", "ATMG00060", "ATCG00600", "ATMG00220", "ATMG01170", "ATMG00410", "AT1G78900", "AT3G55440", "ATMG01320", "AT2G21170" ,"AT5G08670", "AT5G53300", "ATMG00070", "AT1G26630", "AT5G48300", "AT2G33040", "AT5G08690", "AT1G57720")
stabletable <- mean_mT0norm[stablegenes, ]
normFactors <- colMeans(stabletable)

nF <- vector()
ind <- sapply(names(normFactors), function(x) grep(x, colnames(mT0norm)))
for(i in 1:ncol(ind)){
nF[ind[, i]] <- colnames(ind)[i]
}
normFactorsM <- t(matrix(rep(normFactors[nF], nrow(mT0norm)), ncol = nrow(mT0norm)))

mT0norm_2 <- data.frame(mT0norm/normFactorsM, 
                     row.names = rownames(mT0norm))

# Reshaping
mT0norm_2.1 <- reshape2::melt(as.matrix(mT0norm_2), varnames = c("geneID", "variable"))
mT0norm_2.1 <- cbind(mT0norm_2.1, reshape2::colsplit(mT0norm_2.1$variable, "_", names = c("treatment", "t.decay", "rep")))
mT0norm_2.1 <- mT0norm_2.1[, colnames(mT0norm_2.1) !=  "variable"]
mT0norm_2.1 <- mT0norm_2.1[, c(1, 3, 4, 5, 2)]
colnames(mT0norm_2.1) <- c("geneID", "treatment", "t.decay", "rep", "value")
mT0norm_2.1$rep <- gsub("r", "rep", mT0norm_2.1$rep)
mT0norm_2.1$t.decay <- as.numeric(gsub("7", "7.5", as.numeric(mT0norm_2.1$t.decay)))
mT0norm_2.1$treatment <- factor(mT0norm_2.1$treatment,levels = c("WT","sov","vcs","vs"))
mT0norm_2.1$rep <- factor(mT0norm_2.1$rep, levels = paste0("rep",1:4))

# Sorting (REQUIRED)
decay_data <- decay_data[order(decay_data$t.decay), ]
decay_data <- decay_data[order(decay_data$rep), ]
decay_data <- decay_data[order(as.numeric(decay_data$treatment)), ] 
decay_data <- decay_data[order(decay_data$geneID), ]
ids <- as.character(unique(decay_data$geneID))

# Model Setup
groups <- groupings(decay_data)
mods <- data.frame(
  "a" = as.vector(sapply(1:nEquivGrp, function(x) {rep(x, nEquivGrp + 1)})),
  "b" = rep(1:(nEquivGrp + 1), nEquivGrp),
  row.names = paste0("mod", 1:(nEquivGrp*(nEquivGrp+1)))
)

# Bounds
a_bounds <- c(a_low(max(decay_data$t.decay)),
             a_high(min(unique(decay_data$t.decay)[unique(decay_data$t.decay)>0])))
b_bounds <- c(b_low(max(decay_data$t.decay)), 0.075)

# Optimization
mod_optimization("AT2G18150", decay_data, group = groups, mod = mods, a_bounds, b_bounds, c("mod1", "mod2", "mod16", "mod239", "mod240"), file_only = FALSE, path = wrdir)

# Model Selection
results <- t(sapply(models, function(x) x[x[, "AICc"] == min(x[, "AICc"]), ]))
results <- as.data.frame(results)
results[, 1:2] <- sapply(as.data.frame(results[, 1:2]), function(x) as.character(unlist(x)))
results[, -c(1,2)] <- sapply(results[, -c(1,2)], unlist)

# Visualization
p <- decay_plot(geneID = "AT1G02860", 
              xlim = c(0, 350), 
              ylim = c(0, 1.25), 
              xticks = 1:5*100, 
              yticks = 0:5/4,
              alphaSZ  =  12, 
              what  =  c("meanSE", "reps", "models"),
              treatments  =  c("WT", "vcs.sov"), 
              colors = c("darkblue", "red3"),
              DATA = decay_data, 
              mod.results = results, 
              gdesc = descriptions)

p <- hl_plot(geneID = "AT1G02860",
             gene_symbol = "SYG1",
             df_decay_rates = RNAdecay::results,
             hl_dist_treatment = "WT",
             hl_treatment = c("WT","sov","vcs","vcs.sov"),
             arrow_lab_loc = "key"
             )
